question: Should CodexBar adopt a permanent local-only usage-card export, and should its shared subscription aggregation be coordinated with https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2116?
rationale: The patch adds new menu and Settings product surfaces, while the companion draft proposes another permanent presentation over substantially overlapping aggregation data; code review cannot choose that long-term product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor Local Export
options.body: Approve the narrow local-only card and text export, while requiring a reusable aggregation seam, unique row identities, and complete native proof before merge.

options.title: Fold Into Dashboard
options.body: Defer this standalone surface and expose sharing only through the dashboard if https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2116 is approved.

options.title: Decline Sharing Surface
options.body: Keep CodexBar focused on private in-app monitoring and do not add a permanent sharing workflow.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Local Export
recommendation.body: Approve the narrow local-only card and text export, while requiring a reusable aggregation seam, unique row identities, and complete native proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the best available owner for the explicit VISION.md product-surface decision and coordination between the two drafts.
